principle: Pair a hero's kit-based struggle with a partner whose kit solves exactly that; both builds change for it; one-button, >=1.5s spare.
evidenceStatus: council/evidence has no <hero>.json and sandbox/results is empty, so every hypothesis is inconclusive (untested). Builds stand on file numbers; each scenario's decision rule says what to revert.

struggles.Bebop: Hyper Beam is an 11s channel (1.0s cast, 1.8 m/s move) in a 2.9m beam; his hook only restricts 0.5s, so nothing holds the target in the beam.
struggles.Grey Talon: Charged Shot and Guided Owl (1.5s cast delay, 0.75s stun) need a still target; Spirit Snare is a 6m tether, not a root, and arms in 2.0s.
struggles.Kelvin: No hard CC: slows only (Frost Grenade 32%, Shelter 28%); his dome and heals need allies who stay inside 10m for 5s.
struggles.Mina: Nox Nostra (2.5s of bats, 20 deg lock cone, cd 150) needs the target held in front of her; Love Bites needs 5s of build-up.
struggles.Rat King: Rat Swarm shred and Scrap Grenade's 3.0s of detonations need targets that stay put; any dash shakes the rats off.
struggles.Violet: Still Life is a 2.6s channel that only stuns at the end; the subject can walk out of range or line of sight.
struggles.Viscous: Goo Ball stun is 0.5s per hit; damage is low and needs clumped enemies in a 1.8m roll path.
struggles.Holliday: Spirit Lasso (0.5s cast, 2.25s) drags one target next to a squishy gun hero; she needs someone to kill it there.
struggles.Abrams: Melee-range brawler with no pull: Seismic Impact (1.6s stun, 9m) and Siphon (8m) only work if enemies stay close; gets kited.
struggles.Paradox: Paradoxical Swap (110-150s) moves an enemy into her team and her into theirs; she then needs the swapped target killed fast.
struggles.McGinnis: Heavy Barrage is 8s in a 4.5m zone while she is self-slowed; no CC of her own holds a target that long.
struggles.Haze: Sleep Dagger breaks 0.1s after any damage, so partners can't follow it up; Bullet Dance needs enemies within 16m while she is exposed.
struggles.Solomon: Develop Queen stun is 1.25s; most damage is zone squares that enemies walk off; Rook root only at T3.
struggles.Venator: Melee/close range: Gutshot only stuns with a wall within 7m and Snap Trap needs the enemy to step on a 2m spot.
struggles.Baba: Feed The Birds is a 6.5s channel needing targets in a 40 deg cone; Threadsap pull is 7m only at T3.
struggles.Vindicta: Assassinate needs 1.0s of scope for full damage and a still target at range; Stake is a 9m tether, not a root.
struggles.Mirage: Dust Devil lift is 0.2s and Djinn's Mark needs 4-5 stacks over 5s; no hold of her own.
struggles.Calico: Return to Shadows hits twice in 7.5m 3s apart; enemies walk out of the return blast unless held.
struggles.Shiv: Killing Blow only executes under 18% (28% at T3) and enemies heal back out; a failed cast costs +30% cooldown.
struggles.Warden: Binding Word only roots after 2.8s if the target stays within 20m; dashes and knockbacks break it.
struggles.Silver: Bola locks movement abilities 1.5-2.25s but she has no hold; Boot Kick pushes targets away from her team.
struggles.Dynamo: Singularity is a 2.75s channel at 0 move speed with a 7-9m pull centred on him; he is stuck in their team while it runs.
struggles.Infernus: Concussive Combustion stuns only after a delay around himself (12-22m); enemies walk out before it pops.
struggles.Rem: Naptime sleep (4s) breaks on any hit over 100+3.1 x boons, so most partner burst wakes it early; Rem has almost no damage.
struggles.Wraith: Telekinesis lifts one target 2.25s at 10m cast range, so she must be close; her gun needs bullets landing for cards.
struggles.The Doorman: Cart and doors move enemies but never hold or kill them; a displaced enemy walks back through the door (15s doors).
struggles.Drifter: Bloodscent amp needs isolated targets (no ally within 20m); he lacks his own way to isolate outside the ult.
struggles.Apollo: His ult gives the victim -70% damage taken for 1.8s, so partner burst during it is wasted; 1.5s cast delay.
struggles.Lady Geist: Soul Exchange has 5.5m cast range and costs her health; she needs an engage that keeps her alive at that range.
struggles.Sinclair: Rabbit Hex is 2s with a 0.9s detonation delay; hexed rabbits move fast and out of his zones.
struggles.Billy: Chain Gang (2.8s, cd 175) pulls enemies onto him; his own follow-up damage is small (45 DPS +0.9x).
struggles.Ivy: Air Drop carries an ally who can't shoot and deals -20% while lifted; her own damage is the 115+0.7x drop.
struggles.Danny: Single-target kit; Close The Deal needs the target within 10m and hurts Danny too (0.4s self stun).
struggles.Paige: Captivating Read immobilises 1.0-2.0s after a delay; Bookwyrm trail needs targets held on it.
struggles.Seven: Storm Cloud is a 7-14s channel, cd 205; Seven barely moves (1.5 m/s) and enemies walk out or stun him out of it.
struggles.Victor: Aura of Suffering is 8-9m around him; he is slow and melee-range, so enemies kite out of the aura.
struggles.Yamato: Power Slash needs a 1.4s charge on a still target; after Shadow Transformation ends she is exposed.
struggles.Mo & Krill: Combo is a 2.4s (3.1s T3) single-target hold at 4m, so he has to Burrow into their team (cd 40) and channels there with no escape.
struggles.Lash: Death Slam lands him in the middle of the enemies he slammed (6m), with no escape after.
struggles.Graves: Ghouls are slow and kiteable; Grasping Hands only roots enemies who walk through it (1.7s to arm) and the gravestone dies to two heavy melees.
struggles.Pocket: Affliction (13m, 13s, blocks healing at T3) is non-lethal and can't proc items, so it never kills.
struggles.Celeste: Radiant Daggers explode after 1.4s and Dazzling Trick silences only when the barrier breaks; she needs targets held.
struggles.Vyper: Petrify blocks damage, so partner burst during it is wasted; Lethal Venom wants targets already low (30% HP max damage).

pairs.struggleA: Combo is a 2.4s (3.1s T3) single-target hold at 4m, so he has to Burrow into their team (cd 40) and channels there with no escape.
pairs.struggleB: Bebop's hook is his only tool and it restricts the victim 0.5s; a hook on an ally is a rescue only if it reaches them in time.
pairs.combo: Mo can't Combo in their team without getting melted. Bebop hooks Mo out mid-Combo and the held target comes with him.
pairs.numbers: Hook from 20m: 0.1 cast + 0.28 flight (2850u/s) + 0.5 impact delay + 0.39 reel (2000u/s) + 0.3 reaction = 1.57s. Combo T3 3.1s -> 1.53s spare; base 2.4s -> 0.83s (fails). Hook ignores allies within 8m, so Bebop stands 8-20m behind Mo. Hook restriction has no stun flag; Combo is only interrupted by MODIFIER_STATE_STUNNED. Combo's target is spring-dragged to a point 100u in front of Mo (modifier_drag_custom), so it should follow Mo. Kieran's literal version (hook the target) puts a second drag on a target already dragged to Mo: predicted to fight the hold (arm hook_target).
pairs.gain: Mo leaves their team inside the Combo instead of dying in it; the target dies in Bebop's team inside Combo + 3s kill check (Mo gets +40+2 x boons permanent HP). Combo T3 at 36k: 244 DPS x 3.1s = 756, procs Spirit Burn (500/5s).

Doorway uses wall placement (m_bUseWallPlacement true), Gutshot wall stun needs a wall within 7m: guaranteed at the exit door. Snap Trap: arm 0.5s, lifetime 30s, 2m trigger, root 1.25 +1.0 (T2) = 2.25s x1.22 (Duration Extender, ImmobilizeDuration is ETechDuration-tagged) = 2.75s, then Gutshot stun 1.0s (T2) = ~3.75s locked; 2 charges (3 at T3), cd 17 at T1.
pairs.gain: Every Cart (12.3s) lands on an armed trap: ~3.75s of guaranteed lock at a wall for melee Venator, against 0s from the push alone.

pairs.numbers: Grasping Hands: 0.6 deploy + 1.1 pop, root 1.0s (1.75 T3), duration 7s (T1) x1.22 Duration Extender = 8.5s (AbilityDuration is ETechDuration-tagged), cd 20 at T3: a 6.8s window for a ~1.0s Cart (>=1.5s spare). Decree: 8m aura re-applies a 64% slow every 0.4s, ghouls explode 115+1.27x in 6.5m. Decree's AbilityDuration is tagged ETechPower (16+0.04 x SP), so Duration Extender on it is doubtful: moved to Hands.
pairs.gain: The carted enemy is rooted 1.75s and then held at 36% speed in the ghoul zone instead of walking away; prediction >=2x Decree damage on the target.

pairs.combo: Pocket's Affliction can't kill, and Shiv's Killing Blow only works on low targets who heal back out. Affliction drains their team and blocks healing, and Shiv chains executes with the 16s recast.
pairs.numbers: Affliction T3: 45+0.31 x SP DPS for 13s in 13m (x1.2 = 15.6m with Mystic Expansion), non-lethal, no item procs, blocks all healing. Killing Blow: execute under 18% (+10 at T3 = 28%, +3 buffer), range 12m (+6 T1), 'Finishing an enemy lets you recast for 16s' (RecastWindow 16, duration-tagged). Cooldowns: Affliction 135 x0.8 = 108s, Killing Blow 120 x0.8 = 96s.
pairs.gain: Execute line 18% -> 28% (+~300 HP on a 3000 HP hero) on targets that can't heal; prediction >=2 executes per Killing Blow vs <=1 alone.

consideredDropped.why: Struggle fits (Ivy flies 10-22 m/s so Storm Cloud follows fleeing enemies), but the carried ally deals -20% all damage and whether Storm Cloud can channel while grabbed is UNVERIFIABLE; Ivy's build needs no change (21s carry already covers a 14s storm). Fails 'both builds change' until S-test.
Combo 3.1s >= Binding Word's 2.8s escape check, so the root is guaranteed after the hold, but Mo is already in B3-1 and Warden's build change would be order only.
